Namaste Everyone,
Our journey started in 2020 with a simple goal—to share real experiences as internationally educated physiotherapists navigating life, licensing exams (NPTE & PCE), and careers in Canada and the USA.
What began as a small initiative has grown into MM Physio, now with three active clinics in Cambridge, Guelph, and Kitchener (2026), helping hundreds of patients every month with pain relief, rehabilitation, and better mobility.
On this channel, we share:
• Physio career guidance & licensing journey
• Student & work-life experiences
• Clinical insights & treatment approaches
• Business growth & clinic-building journey
We’re a passionate team committed to helping patients live pain-free while supporting physiotherapists in building successful careers.
All content is based on real experiences—always do your own research.
Join us on this journey 🚀
